data.narrative:
ForSight Robotics, a Series B biotech & health company led by Daniel Glozman, has raised $195M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 8 private peers and 3 public biotech companies, including Series B–C stage companies such as Eikon Therapeutics ($539M), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B).

Two valuation methods proved applicable. The Stage-Progression method, using the $195M total raised as a proxy base and applying a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $370M. The Peer-Median approach across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a $3.5B implied value, with a range spanning $539M (Eikon Therapeutics floor) to $10.3B (Colossal Biosciences ceiling). Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied; the sector median P/S multiple is 5.5x across RXRX, TEM, and ONT.L, but ForSight's revenue is not disclosed.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $315M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.9B. The wide spread reflects meaningful uncertainty around stage positioning within the Series B cohort and comparability of clinical-stage risk profiles across peers. Capital raised and peer metrics provide the anchor, but absence of revenue and milestone-specific progress limits confidence in a tighter range.
